# brouter-mapcreator-profiles

**The two filter files BRouter's map creator needs and its release zip leaves out**

- **Version recorded:** 1.7.10
- **Categories:** `navigation-maps`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/abrensch/brouter>

## What it does

Installs two small files, all.brf and softaccess.brf, from BRouter 1.7.10's source under /usr/local/share/hammunition/data/brouter-mapcreator-profiles/. Nothing reads them but `brouter-segments`, which passes them to BRouter's map creator when it builds your routing files.

## Why you would want it

BRouter's map creator needs them to decide which roads and paths go into the routing files, and BRouter's release zip does not carry them.

## Before it will work

None.

## How it installs

- data (MIT, https://github.com/abrensch/brouter/blob/master/LICENSE): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abrensch/brouter/4d2639af77ea5ed9c30d3e400764eb6f9e8522da/misc/profiles2/all.brf (511 bytes), https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abrensch/brouter/4d2639af77ea5ed9c30d3e400764eb6f9e8522da/misc/profiles2/softaccess.brf (631 bytes)

## Known problems

None known. They are map-creation filters, not routing profiles, and are deliberately kept out of the profile directory QMapShack lists.

## Keeping it current

- probe: none
- strategy: reinstall
- Bumped with `brouter`: pin the new tag's commit in both URLs, download both files, measure their sha256 and size, and bump `version`.
